sentences.show: The stock market lost 11 percent at the opening bell. One man walked onto the trading floor to stop it.
It was Black Thursday, on this day in 1929.
Panic selling had been building all week.
A record 12.9 million shares changed hands.
The ticker tape fell hours behind. Nobody knew what anything was worth.
The biggest bankers met, and sent in Richard Whitney, the Exchange's vice-president.
In front of everyone, he bid for 25,000 shares of U.S. Steel, far above the market price.
The slide stopped. They called him the White Knight of Wall Street.
It didn't last. On Black Tuesday, the market collapsed.
As for the White Knight: nine years later, he went to Sing Sing prison, for embezzlement.
Also on this day: Concorde made its last passenger flight, and the United Nations came into existence.
